description:
The FINTRX MCP Server connects ChatGPT to FINTRX, giving you direct access to data on registered investment advisors, broker-dealers, wealth teams, and family offices.


With FINTRX connected, you can search and analyze intelligence across 850,000+ firm and contact records, including 45,000+ RIAs and broker-dealers and 4,500+ family offices. Identify key decision-makers, analyze ETF and portfolio holdings, uncover relationship signals, and build prospect lists — all through natural language.


Whether you’re distributing funds, raising capital, recruiting advisors, or identifying M&A opportunities, use FINTRX data directly inside ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Advisors at Morgan Stanley in the Southeast US managing $50M+, tenure < 3yr
